name: DeepSeek dsh-superagent
tagline: DeepSeek's MIT research prototype of an always-on coding agent that watches one GitHub repo (and optionally Feishu), opens a work item per allowed request, works it in its own session, and replies with a pull request

xSignals.text: DeepSeek open-sourced dsh-superagent: it watches your GitHub, runs requests in parallel worker sessions and replies with a PR. Their own docs say it runs with full OS user access, isolate it first.

DeepSeek released a new open-source agent, DSH SuperAgent: a coding agent that watches GitHub repo events and can open pull requests on its own, with docs explaining step by step how the system was built. (translated from Arabic)
